corrections.text: The article quotes SiliconANGLE as saying the model "classifies safety of AI model outputs with single-token verdicts ('yes' or 'no')." This is a paraphrase, not SiliconANGLE's actual wording. The source states: "It also provides a verdict in the form of a single token: a 'yes' or a 'no,' making the result completely unambiguous." The substance of the claim is accurate; the quotation marks incorrectly presented a paraphrase as verbatim text.
